verificationMethod: Public GET requests and committed configuration/source inspection only; no production model calls or mutations.

database.method: The 105 approved records are bundled into the staging Worker and merged in memory. Underlying publication tables still report 891. No schema migration, embedding upload or record insertion/update/deletion was performed.
database.connectionTopology: Database secret values were not read. Separate database branches are not claimed; production isolation does not depend on them because no database state was changed.

deploymentCommands: Only wrangler deploy --config cloudflare/wrangler.informatics-staging.toml and deploy-panthur-staging.sh informatics were used.
